evidence.observation: Pressure rising monotonically during growth from 3.02 to 3.51 Torr while Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, suggesting downstream restriction
Flow stable at setpoint 100 sccm, so pressure rise is not from flow change
Temperature tracks 750 °C setpoint with normal heater power
O2 exhaust sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak status cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (not installed) to distinguish air ingress from a blockage; a pump-down/flow-step test showing pressure response would discriminate exhaust restriction vs seal leak.
